answer: Agents routing copper shipments through a canyon could earn only with an exclusive radio-spectrum lease. An audit thread records each regulator-issued lease serial once per epoch, bound to one signing key; duplicate claims earn nothing. Every extra alias must lease another slot at a recurring price above its capped extra reward, even if colluders run in parallel. This assumes an honest spectrum registry, enforceable exclusivity and a credible reward ceiling; sham leases break it. Short, low-capacity leases provide a newcomer path, though cost excludes some honest agents.
